30068647_4c023496.text: We used two-photon imaging, infrared-differential interference contrast microscopy and patch clamp recordings from rat hippocampal slices to define the intrinsic physiology and synaptic targets of spiny, granule-like neurons in the IML, termed semilunar granule cells (SGCs)

30068647_f4e78cdf.text: These neurons resembled dentate granule cells but had axon collaterals in the molecular layer, significantly larger dendritic arborization in the molecular layer, and a more triangular cell body than granule cells.
